author: SciShow
description:
Maps are amazing tools for navigation, but that's not /all/ they are. Maps can change how we view the world, and can tell us how it /was/ viewed and what we understood at the time the map was made. Today we’re talking about 5 maps that changed history, some for the better, some… maybe up for debate.

Hosted by: Denali Kincaid (they/them)
